author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage visits Fotokem's color timing lab where every 70MM film they develop goes to be seen for the very first time after leaving a camera. Using a blow-up of a One Day Build as an example, Fotokem technicians show us how film negative runs through a color analyzer to be timed and corrected based on the vision of the filmmakers. It's the first time we've seen our footage printed on large format film!

How IMAX 70MM Film is Developed: https://youtu.be/WejZgrMZSL8
